name: It Was Me, Dio!
look: An anime still of Dio Brando from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, a young man with spiky blond hair and a cream high-collared outfit, grinning smugly with his mouth open and jabbing a thumb at himself. Dark trees and a blood-red sky fill the background.
use: A bait-and-switch reveal. The setup says you expected one thing, and the punchline reveals it was something else all along, with Dio as the smug surprise, echoing his boast from the show.
slots: top caption: what you thought it was
bottom caption: but it was me, the real surprise
examples: You thought that was a chocolate chip cookie
But it was me, oatmeal raisin!
You thought the meeting could have been an email
But it was me, a second meeting about the first meeting!
describe: anime blond guy pointing at himself with a smug grin
jojo villain thumbs at his chest laughing
dio brando smirking you thought it was something else
blonde anime man revealing it was him all along
jojo bizarre adventure surprise reveal villain
origin: Dio Brando's boast from Phantom Blood, the first arc of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, as shown in the 2012 anime adaptation.
